scope: Primary API contract notes for test-only launcher; not a native result

sources.summary: The primary token selects the child context. Mutable command-line storage is required. Extended startup attributes require EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT. Process and thread handles returned on success must be closed. The caller may need privileges and the API can temporarily enable required privileges; the candidate retains exact actual child-token comparison and does not add a fallback.

HANDLE_LIST specifies inheritable non-pseudo handles and requires bInheritHandles true. JOB_LIST lists jobs assigned as part of creation. Attribute value buffers must live until the attribute list is destroyed.
GroupCount describes the number of group entries and Groups is a variable array. The candidate does not change production zero-restricting-SID rejection.
ReturnLength reports required buffer bytes; a zero-length query can fail while reporting needed size. Native11 did not log the actual needed value, which remains unknown.
